## The Way of the Okama

Ballet turned into a fighting art: grace, flamboyant poses and kicks that hit like a cannon. Bon Clay would weep.

Fight with the Okama Kenpo style.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Fight as Okama Kenpo

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +5 Training Points (your style)

## Newkama Land

Under Impel Down, between the fifth level and the sixth, the okama made a paradise of their own and danced in it.

Go through a Gate of Justice into Impel Down and reach 25,000 Doriki.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Ohikae na Fouette](st_okama_kenpo.md#q-1865ac884cadad39), [Bombardier Arabesque](st_okama_kenpo.md#q-395b8a1b218eb3bb)

**Tasks**

- Go through a Gate of Justice
- Reach 25,000 Doriki

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +60,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +8 Training Points (your style)
